capabilities: Convert plain-text note title and alias mentions into wiki links as you edit or on save
Scan the whole vault and add links in one run
Map extra search terms to notes via an alias masterlist file, with optional write-back to YAML aliases
Skip code blocks, inline code, existing links, YAML properties, tables, math, and optionally headings
Scope matching with include/exclude folder patterns and per-line block/folder/root tags
extras: README warns users to back up the vault before running the vault-wide link scan and discloses that the plugin was created with AI assistance under human supervision.
problem: Obsidian only links notes when you write wiki links yourself; plain-text mentions of existing note titles stay unlinked unless you create each link manually.
summary: Auto-linking plugin that converts plain-text mentions of note titles and aliases into wiki links, with configurable matching, folder scoping, and an alias masterlist.
